final_text:
The catalog-wide Bonferroni threshold for the NHANES EP-WAS meta-analysis (model 6) is **p < 7.5e-10**.

This threshold is calculated based on correcting for **66,458,160** independent tests performed in the catalog for that adjustment model (2,556 exposures × 25,998 phenotypes).
